cmd: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$all = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process; foreach ($p in ($all | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'python*' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*worker.py*' -and $_.CommandLine -notlike '*telugucouple*' })) { $par = $all | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -eq $p.ParentProcessId }; Write-Output ('pid ' + $p.ProcessId + ' parent: ' + $par.CommandLine); if ($par.CommandLine -like '*siri*') { Stop-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -Force; Write-Output ('killed siri worker pid ' + $p.ProcessId) } }; Start-Sleep 2; $all = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process; $all | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'python*' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*worker.py*' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('still running: ' + $_.ProcessId + ' ' + $_.CommandLine) }"
